name: DECO BLUE SR HPR - Distinctive Specialties
short_description:
Introducing the DECO BLUE SR HPR – a decorative and privacy-enhancing blue window film that not only amplifies the aesthetic appeal of your space but also delivers exceptional performance. Crafted to meet the technical standards set by EN 410 and EN 673, this versatile film is optimized for both single (4mm) and double (4/16/4 mm) glazing applications. 
 The DECO BLUE SR HPR offers a balanced blend of solar energy and visible light control. With a solar energy transmission of 61% for single glazing and 53% for double glazing, it ensures a cooler interior space by rejecting a significant portion of solar heat. Its visible light transmission stands at 29% for single glazing and 27% for double glazing, making it ideal for privacy without sacrificing too much natural light. The film’s blue hue adds a striking decorative touch, while its low external (5% for single, 12% for double) and internal (5% and 6%, respectively) visible light reflection reduces glare by 68%. 
 In terms of UV protection, the film excels by transmitting less than 1% of Ultraviolent rays and providing over 99% rejection, prolonging the lifespan of your interiors and protecting occupants from harmful radiation. Additionally, its shading coefficient and total solar energy rejected figures (0.79, 31% for single; 0.83, 28% for double) highlight its efficiency in managing energy. 
 The DECO BLUE SR HPR also features robust physical properties, including a U value of 6 W/m².K for single glazing and 2.74 W/m².K for double glazing, and an emissivity of 0.9. Its color rendering index of 32 ensures that colors viewed through the film appear natural and vibrant. 
 Backed by a 5-year manufacturer’s limited warranty (Europe only), the DECO BLUE SR HPR is best installed internally and on non-sunlit exterior glazing for optimal results. Installation should follow the Film On guidelines while ensuring thermal stress compatibility. For further details and the latest product information, please refer to your LLumar representative. 
 Enhance your interiors with the unparalleled blend of style and performance of the DECO BLUE SR HPR.
